qualification: Actual final source at production O3; earlier O2 runs are historical and excluded.
comparison: Exact full bytes, including NaN payloads and signed zeros; no canonicalization.
limits: Sampled fixtures, not exhaustive finite coverage.
gfx1030 exercises served fp16; gfx1100 exercises bf16 and additional fp16 instantiations.
Routed fixture uses one item with expert offset/reversed members; no multi-item batch claim.
Signed-zero inputs are included; output negative-zero counts are reported without claiming they must be positive.
reproduction: Use build.py against exact clean tracked sources; execute on the same GPU and compare.py. Build/execute commands are retained in workflow.sh; replace environment paths and choose allocated devices.
